method.ID_representation: FlyWire IDs preserved as strings; exact equality, never floating point or nearest match
method.flywire_selection: root_id equals the two literal notebook ascending IDs; context includes all 12 lgAG2 IDs and every current or publication-release row with cell_type AN_GNG_162
method.male_selection: exact flywireType == AN_GNG_162 across all 166,700 processed records; original raw annotation metadata independently agrees

interpretation.two_extra_cells_role: ascending interneurons, not the primary gustatory sensory group
interpretation.flow_afferent_means: brain-directed; does not by itself identify a primary sensory receptor
interpretation.SA_context: The 12 lgAG2 IDs are SA_VTV_2. Published v2.1.0 labels use super_class ascending and cell_class AN; current v3.1.0 uses sensory_ascending and gustatory. The SA subtype is retained across releases.
interpretation.current_cell_type_annotation_receptive_f: gustatory for SA_VTV_2; no independently verified sugar selectivity or represented-leg side for the two AN_GNG_162 cells
interpretation.mapping_level: type-family only: eight FlyWire AN_GNG_162 cells and eight MaleCNS cells, split between six AN01B004 and two ANXXX255 cells; no per-cell ID join
interpretation.isomorphic_annotation: present for both exact FlyWire IDs in the current release; insufficient for unique male identity or identical physiology
interpretation.side_semantics: Current and published side is nerve-entry side for sensory and ascending neurons. Notebook labels are opposite, with the represented-leg definition unresolved; this is not an established error.
interpretation.engineering_comparison: Direct excitation of two central ascending cells adds a different encoding entry point. It is not evidence that every sensory_ascending input bypasses primary afferents or that Eon biological function is reproduced.

primary_paper_sections.hierarchical_annotation: sensory: periphery to brain; ascending: VNC to brain; these can both have afferent flow
primary_paper_sections.ANs_and_DNs: AN identification uses absent brain soma and incoming neck branch; SA is distinguished using MANC morphology and tract membership
primary_paper_sections.FAFB_laterality: Left/right labels in published annotations are corrected for image-acquisition inversion; raw display orientation is not interchangeable with biological side

known_limitations_and_access_notes: Initial bundled Python read_feather failed because pyarrow was absent; project .venv succeeded without installation
Initial rg omitted ignored data; corrected with --no-ignore
Two exact-ID VFB pages were discovery leads only; primary repository rows and column definitions govern conclusions
Primary article public GET returned full readable HTML despite the cookies_not_supported redirect
No per-cell FlyWire ID in MaleCNS metadata; no arbitrary one-to-one selection
No physiological study acquired establishing sugar response or receptive-field side for the two AN_GNG_162 cells
